primary_sources.title: VMem: Consistent Interactive Video Scene Generation with Surfel-Indexed View Memory
primary_sources.supports: Surfel-indexed view memory stores and retrieves historical views for revisit consistency.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: A fixed-state, single-source total causal effect localized to the source geometry support.

primary_sources.title: Video World Models with Long-term Spatial Memory
primary_sources.supports: Spatial, working and episodic memory are processed and injected as a conditional signal.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Per-source causal acceptance or output-region localization.

primary_sources.title: WorldMem: Long-term Consistent World Simulation with Memory
primary_sources.supports: Memory units pair frames with state information and are consumed by state-aware memory attention.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Fixed-state counterfactual attribution of one runtime memory item.

primary_sources.title: Learning World Models for Interactive Video Generation
primary_sources.supports: Naive long context or RAG can be ineffective when the video generator has limited in-context learning; explicit global state conditioning is introduced.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Runtime source-to-region causal intervention.

primary_sources.title: Context as Memory: Scene-Consistent Interactive Long Video Generation with Memory Retrieval
primary_sources.venue_status: SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 author project page and arXiv
primary_sources.code_status: Author project page displayed GitHub as Coming Soon at retrieval time.
primary_sources.supports: Historical frames are selected using field-of-view overlap and provided as frame-formatted context.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Causal source attribution or evidence acceptance.

primary_sources.title: Memory Forcing: Spatio-Temporal Memory for Consistent Scene Generation on Minecraft
primary_sources.supports: The official abstract reports that over-reliance on insufficient spatial context can degrade new-scene quality and proposes hybrid spatio-temporal memory training.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: A per-query accept or reject rule grounded in single-source causal localization.

primary_sources.title: Teaching Video Generators to Remember: Training-Time Memory for Long-Horizon World Simulation
primary_sources.code_status: Public README exposed inference; training code was not present at retrieval time.
primary_sources.supports: Training uses damaged or dropped memory and protected anchors to improve long-horizon memory use; the work exposes KV-importance-style diagnostics.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Per-source fixed-state counterfactual acceptance; keyword checks of the arXiv HTML did not find counterfactual, causal, accept or reject terminology.

primary_sources.title: Addressable Memory for Video World Models
primary_sources.code_status: No official code repository was retrieved in the recorded targeted searches.
primary_sources.supports: Out-of-training positional offsets and compression in RoPE space can make stored KV content unaddressable; virtual in-distribution positions are proposed.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Whether addressed evidence is correct, causally consumed or localized in the output.

primary_sources.title: What the DAAM: Interpreting Stable Diffusion Using Cross Attention
primary_sources.supports: Aggregated cross-attention maps provide word-to-image spatial attribution validated against segmentation and human attribution.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Causal effect of a runtime image-memory source.

primary_sources.title: I2AM: Interpreting Image-to-Image Latent Diffusion Models via Bi-Attribution Maps
primary_sources.supports: Bi-directional reference-to-generated attribution maps are derived by aggregating patch cross-attention across steps, heads and layers.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: A fixed-state counterfactual total effect; the main maps remain attention-based and are validated correlationally.

primary_sources.title: Localizing and Editing Knowledge in Text-to-Image Generative Models
primary_sources.supports: Causal mediation and tracing are adapted to localize concept and attribute knowledge in text-to-image components.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Runtime reference-memory source to generated-region causality.

primary_sources.title: On Mechanistic Knowledge Localization in Text-to-Image Generative Models
primary_sources.supports: The paper reports architecture-sensitive limitations of causal tracing and uses direct cross-attention-layer intervention to localize knowledge.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Single selected runtime memory-source effects or geometry-supported output localization.

primary_sources.title: Towards Best Practices of Activation Patching in Language Models: Metrics and Methods
primary_sources.supports: Localization conclusions vary with corruption, restoration and metric choices.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: A video-memory protocol; it supplies methodological controls for coherent intervention and preregistered metrics.

primary_sources.title: Making Foresight Actionable: Repurposing Representation Alignment for Causally Grounded Video World Models
primary_sources.code_status: No official repository was retrieved in the recorded title and author searches.
primary_sources.supports: Token-level hidden-state perturbations identify action-critical spatial regions by measuring downstream action deviation in a world-model policy interface.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: The intervention target is not one selected memory source and the localized outcome is action deviation rather than a generated video region.

primary_sources.title: Trust but Verify: Adaptive Conditioning for Reference-Based Image Super-Resolution
primary_sources.supports: Adaptive implicit-correlation gating suppresses misleading or misaligned reference conditioning.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Online world-memory source attribution or abstain/re-observe decisions; it makes a generic confidence gate non-novel by itself.

primary_sources.title: Sufficient Context: A New Lens on Retrieval Augmented Generation Systems
primary_sources.supports: Separates insufficient retrieved context from model failure given sufficient context and trains guided abstention.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Geometric video evidence acceptance; it is cross-domain pressure against claiming abstention as a new abstraction.

primary_sources.title: RECOMP: Improving Retrieval-Augmented LMs with Compression and Selective Augmentation
primary_sources.supports: A context compressor can return an empty string when retrieved information is irrelevant or unhelpful.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Causal or geometry-aware acceptance in a video world model.

primary_sources.title: CARE: Context-Aware Retrieval Enhancement for Countering Retrieval-Augmented Generation Failures
primary_sources.supports: A context assessor models unreliable retrieved context under context-parametric conflict and guides use of a more reliable source.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Runtime video-memory source-to-region causality.

primary_sources.title: Out of Sight, Out of Mind? Evaluating State Evolution in Video World Models
primary_sources.supports: Observation and control interventions benchmark state progression, plausibility and coherence when state is out of sight.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Which selected memory source caused which generated region.

primary_sources.title: MemoBench: Benchmarking World Modeling in Dynamically Changing Environments
primary_sources.venue_status: arXiv preprint; author project page labels ECCV 2026
primary_sources.supports: The benchmark measures disappear-reappear consistency using visual, motion, identity, 3D, camera and related output metrics.
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Internal single-source causal consumption or acceptance.

negative_search_result.statement: No exact equivalent was retrieved that jointly performs runtime single-memory intervention, holds all remaining state fixed, changes every real consumption path coherently, localizes output effect against a pre-treatment geometry support baseline, and links that effect to natural failure or benefit.
negative_search_result.interpretation: Search result only. It is not a proof of absence and must not be rewritten as a novelty claim.

Ada-RefSR for adaptive suppression of misleading references
Memory Forcing for evidence that insufficient spatial context can harm generation

pre_gates: G0 stable real natural failure with camera and quality checks
A1 consumer influence and failure relevance
A2-A5 ordinary null, mean, nearest, generic and PoE-style baselines
decisive_experiment.main_intervention: Paired F11 versus F00 using one low-strength appearance-only edit applied coherently through every real consumer path, with retrieval IDs, pose, calibration, latents, actual sampling noise and RNG fixed.
decisive_experiment.localization: Compare in-mask effect concentration with the pre-treatment geometry-mask area baseline and report paired confidence intervals.
decisive_experiment.diagnostic_only: F10 CLIP-only and F01 replace-only expose cross-path conflict and are not the main causal estimand.
decisive_experiment.next_gate: Only after a positive causal-localization pilot, test whether the audit score predicts natural revisit error and whether acceptance has oracle headroom.

kill_criteria: Exact-replay variance is comparable to the measured effect
The memory consumer has no effect or no relevance to the natural failure
F11 total effect confidence lower bound does not exceed replay
Localization confidence lower bound does not exceed the mask-area baseline
Only inconsistent one-path interventions F10 or F01 produce a signal
The localization score does not incrementally predict natural error or benefit
Ordinary null, nearest, generic or PoE baselines absorb the effect
An oracle acceptance policy has no material headroom
The result does not replicate across scenes and a second consumer
A later citation-network audit finds an equivalent joint protocol
